news_risk: No negative news, regulator action or enforcement item found in the sources reachable during this check. Note: the web_search backend was down (connection refused) and general search engines returned unusable/irrelevant results, so news coverage was NOT comprehensively screened — absence of findings here is a coverage gap, not a clean bill of health. Indian Kanoon shows only tax litigation, a 2013 Kerala customs/intelligence-inspector writ, a consumer dispute (John Crasta) and a 2026 Maharashtra writ petition; none of these are regulatory penalties or criminal matters.
rf_supply: No evidence found of supplies to Russia or the CIS. Indian Kanoon full-text search for "Nakoda Machinery" combined with Russia / CIS / export returned zero matching judgments (https://indiankanoon.org/search/?formInput=%22Nakoda%20Machinery%22%20Russia and ...%22CIS%20OR%20Russia%20OR%20export). No customs, B-L or trade-press record of RF/CIS shipments located. Status: not confirmed either way — no positive evidence, and search coverage was incomplete.
note: Sanctions: no match found on the OFAC Sanctions List Search tool (SDN + Non-SDN consolidated, SDN list last updated 23.11.2026) — https://sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov/. UN, EU, UK OFSI and BIS Entity List were NOT queried directly (tool budget/network limits), so sanctions exposure is 'no OFAC hit found', not a full five-list clearance. Per project rule 2, the litigation below is not a rejection ground and is recorded neutrally: the company has a normal commercial/tax litigation profile — Bombay HC income-tax appeals (2021), ITAT Pune appeal (2019), a 2013 Kerala HC writ against a customs Intelligence Inspector, an NCDRC/SC consumer dispute (John Crasta, 2021-2023) and an active 2026 Bombay HC writ against the State of Maharashtra. No criminal proceedings against owners/directors were identified in the sources read. Credit rating: null — no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Brickwork action found or verifiable; not public in the sources reachable. RF/CIS supply: no trace found, but this is a negative search result from partial coverage, not a verified absence. Overall: 'есть сложности' — ordinary Indian litigation load, no sanctions hit, no confirmed RF/CIS channel; recommend a paid sanctions-screening re-run (EU/UK/BIS) and a credit-rating bureau check before onboarding.
